fact: The REOI states SFMIS, launched April 2015, is used by 350+ officials in 61 of 70 budget entities for budget execution, accounting and reporting, and the FMIS is used for government staff payroll and automated banking instructions; an enhancement and roll-out to the FMSs is sought.
title: REOI for SFMIS Enhancement and Roll out to Federal Member States
publisher: Federal Republic of Somalia, Ministry of Finance (SERP, P177298)
